nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Entry point of the SDK v2 surface that re-exports the generated client and server modules, and provides the createOpencode factory that boots a local opencode server and returns a client wired to its URL.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `export *` barrel re-exports plus a composed factory function, so the v2 namespace (client, server, data) is consumable from a single import.

nodes.name: server.ts
nodes.summary: Process-management helpers for the SDK that spawn the `opencode` CLI: createOpencodeServer launches `opencode serve`, parses the listening URL from stdout with timeout/abort handling, and createOpencodeTui launches the interactive TUI with project/model/session/agent flags.
nodes.languageNotes: Config is injected via the OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT environment variable (JSON-serialized) instead of CLI flags, and server readiness is detected by scanning stdout for the `opencode server listening` banner.

nodes.name: sst-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated SST ambient type declaration that pulls in the `sst` module's environment typing for the SDK package.

nodes.name: main.ts
nodes.summary: Storybook server configuration for the component workshop: selects the storybook-solidjs-vite framework and addons, globs stories from packages/ui, and in viteFinal wires Tailwind plus a resolve-alias table that swaps every packages/app context import (`@/context/*`, `@/hooks/use-providers`, `@/components/dialog-select-model*`, `@solidjs/router`) for the lightweight mocks under .storybook/mocks.
nodes.languageNotes: Regex-anchored alias entries (`/^@\/context\/local$/`) shadow the catch-all `{ find: "@", replacement: app }` alias, so mock substitutions win over real app modules while unrelated `@/...` imports still resolve to packages/app/src.

nodes.name: manager.ts
nodes.summary: Storybook manager-side script that registers the opencode theme-toggle toolbar tool (rendered by ThemeTool) for story and docs view modes.

nodes.name: dialog-select-model-unpaid.tsx
nodes.summary: Stub replacing the app's unpaid-model dialog with a static placeholder div so stories can render without the real billing UI.

nodes.name: dialog-select-model.tsx
nodes.summary: Mock of the app's ModelSelectorPopover that renders any passed trigger component with its props and children, decoupling stories from the real model-picker dialog.

nodes.name: command.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app command context returning an empty options list and a static keybind map (mod+u attach, mod+m model, etc.) so components can render keyboard hints without the command registry.

nodes.name: comments.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app comments context backed by module-level Solid signals, providing in-memory list/replace/remove/clear plus focus and active setters for comment-driven stories.

nodes.name: file.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app file context exposing tab-path helpers and a case-insensitive fuzzy search over a static pool of five source paths, standing in for real filesystem access in stories.

nodes.name: global-sync.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app global-sync context wrapping a Solid store with a static anthropic provider listing and per-session todo setters, simulating cross-window state sync for stories.

nodes.name: language.ts
nodes.summary: Mock i18n context for the app language module: hardcodes the `en` locale, serves a ~55-entry English dictionary covering prompt/command/dialog strings, and renders `{{param}}` template substitutions.

nodes.name: layout.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app layout context providing signal-backed tab open/activate tracking, a review panel visibility flag, and no-op fileTree/handoff setters for layout-dependent stories.

nodes.name: local.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app local context offering signal-backed agent selection over a build/review/plan list and a Claude 3.7 Sonnet model with fast/thinking variants.

nodes.name: permission.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app permission context tracking auto-accept toggles in a module-level Set keyed by directory+sessionID, with autoResponds always disabled.

nodes.name: platform.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app platform context typed against the real `Platform` interface from packages/app/src/context/platform, returning a web platform with no-op navigation/notifications and a passthrough markdown parser.

nodes.name: prompt.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app prompt context: defines the ContentPart/Prompt types (text, file, agent, image), and manages a signal-backed prompt buffer with cursor position plus a context-item list supporting add/remove and comment update/replace operations.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level `createSignal` state means every story shares one prompt store; `withKey` assigns monotonic `ctx:N` keys to context items so comment updates can be keyed.

nodes.name: sdk.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app SDK context returning a stub client whose session/prompt/shell/command/abort and worktree methods resolve immediately, pointed at a fake localhost:4096 server URL.

nodes.name: sync.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app sync context exposing a Solid store pre-shaped for sessions, permissions, questions, session diffs, messages, session status, agents, and commands, with no-op optimistic session helpers.

nodes.name: use-providers.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app useProviders hook returning a single static anthropic provider with Claude 3.7 Sonnet across all/default/connected/paid/popular listings.

nodes.name: solid-router.tsx
nodes.summary: Module mock for @solidjs/router that replaces routing hooks with fixed story values (dir slug, story-session id) and turns MemoryRouter/Route into children passthroughs so app components render outside a real router.

nodes.name: playground-css-plugin.ts
nodes.summary: Vite dev-server plugin exposing POST /__playground/apply-css, which lets the timeline playground write CSS property edits back into packages/ui/src/components source files by anchoring on a marker string and replacing the next `prop: value;` occurrence.
nodes.languageNotes: Guards against path traversal by resolving each edit target and requiring it to stay under the components root; writes only proceed when at least one edit in a file succeeded.

nodes.name: preview.tsx
nodes.summary: Storybook preview runtime for the workshop: registers docs/a11y addons and a JSX decorator that wraps every story in MetaProvider, Font, ThemeProvider, DialogProvider, and MarkedProvider, with a Scheme component syncing the toolbar theme global to light/dark root classes.
nodes.languageNotes: Theme changes propagate through the Storybook addon channel's GLOBALS_UPDATED event, bridging the manager-side toolbar toggle to SolidJS effects that set `document.documentElement` classes.

nodes.name: theme-tool.ts
nodes.summary: React toolbar component for the Storybook manager that toggles the global `theme` value between light and dark via a ToggleButton.
nodes.languageNotes: The manager UI is React-based while stories are SolidJS, so this tool uses React's createElement rather than Solid JSX.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Workspace manifest for the @opencode-ai/storybook package defining the storybook dev/build scripts and devDependencies, including the @opencode-ai/ui workspace dependency, Storybook 10 addons, and the storybook-solidjs-vite framework.

nodes.name: createOpencode
nodes.summary: Convenience factory that starts a local opencode server and returns a client bound to the server's resolved URL, giving one-call access to a fully wired SDK instance.

nodes.name: createOpencodeServer
nodes.summary: Spawns `opencode serve` with hostname/port/log-level options, awaits the `opencode server listening` stdout banner to resolve the server URL, and enforces startup timeout, abort-signal, and exit-error rejection with captured process output.

nodes.name: createOpencodeTui
nodes.summary: Launches the interactive opencode TUI as an inherited-stdio child process with optional project/model/session/agent flags and returns a close handle honoring an abort signal.

nodes.name: viteFinal
nodes.summary: Storybook's Vite config hook: merges in the Tailwind and playground-css plugins, dedupes solid-js packages, installs the alias table redirecting app contexts and router imports to the .storybook/mocks stubs, and opens the dev-server FS allowlist to the ui/app/mocks directories.

nodes.name: applyEdits
nodes.summary: Applies a sequence of anchored CSS edits to file content: for each edit it locates the anchor string, regex-matches the next `prop: value;` occurrence after it, and splices in the replacement, collecting per-edit ok/error results.

nodes.name: playgroundCss
nodes.summary: Vite plugin factory that installs a middleware handling POST /__playground/apply-css: validates the JSON edit payload, groups edits by file under the components root (rejecting path escapes), applies them via applyEdits, and writes changed files back to disk.

nodes.name: Scheme
nodes.summary: Headless Solid component that applies the selected color scheme to the shared theme, keeps the document root's light/dark class in sync via effects, and listens for Storybook GLOBALS_UPDATED events so toolbar theme changes take effect live.

nodes.name: ThemeTool
nodes.summary: React toolbar control that reads the `theme` global and flips it between light and dark through updateGlobals, rendering its active state in a ToggleButton.

nodes.name: usePrompt
nodes.summary: Mock prompt hook exposing the shared prompt/cursor/item signals with set/reset/dirty operations and a context sub-API for adding, removing, and updating file context items and their comments.

nodes.name: isPromptEqual
nodes.summary: Structural equality check for two prompts that compares lengths and JSON-serializes each part pairwise, used to compute the dirty flag against DEFAULT_PROMPT.

nodes.name: selectionFromLines
nodes.summary: Converts a simple line range into a full FileSelection with zeroed character offsets, mirroring the app's line-to-selection coercion for file context items.

nodes.name: useFile
nodes.summary: Mock file hook providing tab/path conversion helpers, a load stub, and case-insensitive substring search over the static file pool.

nodes.name: useComments
nodes.summary: Mock comments hook exposing the shared signal store with replace/remove/clear list mutations and direct focus/active signal access.

nodes.name: useLocal
nodes.summary: Mock local hook exposing agent list/current/set selection over build/review/plan and a model API with fast/thinking variant switching backed by shared signals.

nodes.name: usePermission
nodes.summary: Mock permission hook implementing auto-accept toggling per session+directory key in a module-level Set, with autoResponds permanently false.
